prompts.dhanuka:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 2D cartoon character expression sprite sheet for TND Toons editor, DRAFT requiring owner approval.
Input image is the definitive character identity reference. Create ONLY RIGHTMOST boy DHANUKA, spiky black hair with one long curled antenna hair and tiny branched tips, large pointed ears, golden yellow skin, freckles, two big front teeth, bare torso, no clothing, skinny limbs. Keep this exact character design, black outlines, colors, hair silhouette, ears, proportions, freckles, tooth style and outfit from input. No redesign.
Create one transparent 3-column by 2-row sheet, six FULL-BODY standalone sprites, each contained in its own equal cell, all same character scale and same ground baseline within each cell, generous padding, no overlaps, no text, no labels, no shadows/background. Front/three-quarter view exactly as reference. Arrange in strict reading order:
top left joyful smile, top middle sad/downcast, top right surprised;
bottom left angry, bottom middle scared, bottom right crying with tears.
Hands and body pose may express each emotion. Preserve character height/proportions across every pose. Full hair and feet visible, centered in each cell. Do not include any other sibling. Actual transparent alpha background.
